title: Top Month by Revenue
flavorText: Combine aggregation with LIMIT to extract the single best or worst performer from a group.
narrative: The Bureau wants to know which single month generated the most total revenue.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, month TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1,'Jan','Datapad',3,899.97),(2,'Jan','Power Cell',10,199.90),(3,'Feb','Datapad',5,1499.95),(4,'Feb','Logic Board',2,179.98),(5,'Mar','Optic Lens',1,149.99),(6,'Mar','Servo Motor',4,220.00),(7,'Mar','Datapad',2,599.98),(8,'Apr','Power Cell',20,399.80),(9,'Apr','Logic Board',5,449.95),(10,'Apr','Steel Cable',50,425.00);
task: Find the month with the highest total sales amount.

hints.text: GROUP BY month, ORDER BY total_sales DESC, then LIMIT 1 to get the top row only.
SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;
